title: Tooltip
summary: A small label that appears on hover or focus. Use it to name an icon button or add a hint; anything the person needs to read belongs on the page or in a popover.

demos.title: Hint
demos.note: A short, non-essential hint on hover or keyboard focus. It is never the only place a piece of information lives.

demos.title: Sides
demos.note: Top is the default. It moves to the opposite side when there is no room.

demos.title: Icon toolbar
demos.note: Icon-only buttons keep their aria-label and get a tooltip that says the same thing. After the first one opens, its neighbours open without the delay.
